problem_keywords: discrepancy between reported and actual work
propositions: Cancelled ACLI link deletes due to stdin=DEVNULL EOF at confirmation prompts are incorrectly counted toward links_applied, inflating reported success metrics
The except CalledProcessError arm in _update_one_dispatch_links lacks idempotent race detection and has no logging, creating silent miscounts that bypass the REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP canary
Missing --yes flag on both link subcommands (workitem link create/delete) causes deterministic cancellation every pass, producing permanent silent divergence rather than transient noise
Idempotent link removal failures (404, 409, not-found, does-not-exist) must be distinguished from non-idempotent failures and matched across both stderr and stdout streams per acli.py:739 precedent
A new links_failed counter must track non-idempotent failures, be carried through apply_handlers onto the outcome, and printed in batch_outcome for canary observability
The link dispatch phase requires extraction to a separate function to avoid exceeding complexity/size constraints while implementing narrowed idempotent detection and per-stream matching
